mapper.select: SELECT a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.content, a.seo_title, a.seo_description, a.seo_keywords, a.publish_time, a.update_date, c.category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, c.description AS category_description FROM tb_seo_article a INNER JOIN tb_seo_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} WHERE a.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} AND a.article_status = #{published} AND a.slug = #{slug}

SELECT c.category_name, c.slug, c.description, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_seo_category c INNER JOIN tb_seo_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} AND a.article_status = #{published} WHERE c.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.slug, c.description, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT g.tag_name, g.slug, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_seo_tag g INNER JOIN tb_seo_article_tag t ON t.tag_id = g.id INNER JOIN tb_seo_article a ON a.id = t.article_id AND a.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} AND a.article_status = #{published} WHERE g.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} AND g.tag_status = #{enabled} GROUP BY g.id, g.tag_name, g.slug ORDER BY article_count DESC, g.id ASC

SELECT c.slug, MAX(a.update_date) AS update_date FROM tb_seo_category c INNER JOIN tb_seo_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} AND a.article_status = #{published} WHERE c.is_deleted = #{notDeleted} GROUP BY c.id, c.slug ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
